tasks.short: Prepare project status reports and correspondence.

steps.what: Prepare project reports from stored specifications.
Review project reports on activities and status.

tasks.design: The {PROJECT} report is the specification, activity, and status it already stores. The developer reviews it and accepts the correspondence built from those fields. {EMAIL} sends that version. Nothing writes a status the record does not hold.
tasks.previous_blocker: Status was copied out of the project record into a letter.
tasks.enabler_now: The project record can already list specification, activity, and status, and a letter can be filled from those fields.
tasks.still_hard: A status the record does not hold still has to be written by the developer, or left out.
tasks.human_edge: The developer reviews the report and accepts the correspondence before it is sent.
tasks.altitude: The developer still reviews the report and accepts the correspondence. The send uses only that version.

reach.task: Read status correspondence the developer accepted
reach.learn: Do not treat the letter as a new status

evidence.claim: A project record that already stores specification, activity, and status can fill a report. The person still accepts correspondence before it is sent.
EU rules require literacy for a person who uses a system that drafts text or code. A user-facing bot must identify itself as a machine. This design has no bot.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a status is due and ends when the accepted correspondence is sent. The developer reviews the report and accepts the letter.

The fields are the specification, the activity, the status, and their acceptance. The project record produces those three. The developer produces the acceptance. If a field is blank, that line is omitted.
The prior classes this task as automate. The steps agree the report can be assembled from stored fields. They disagree that the correspondence can leave before acceptance.
unknowns: Whether specification, activity, and status are already fields.
Who is allowed to receive the correspondence.
research_questions: Are specification, activity, and status already fields?
Who is allowed to receive the correspondence?

already_counted.description: The remaining review on this step stays with the software developer
The whole step stays with the software developer

incremental.description: Keep the correspondence fields aligned with the project record

approvals.approved_version: status correspondence the software developer accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If specification, activity, and status are not fields, preparing the report stays, and the low end is that preparation plus the review, which stays either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend and file an installation plan.

steps.what: Retrieve information on the existing system.
Analyze that information for the installation.

tasks.design: The developer retrieves the existing system record on {PROJECT}, then analyzes it and recommends the installation. They accept the plan. {DOCS} files that version. Nothing recommends an installation.
tasks.previous_blocker: The record was already there, and the recommendation was retyped into a plan.
tasks.enabler_now: The project record can show the existing system. The recommendation is still a judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing a new system or a modification is still the developer's decision.
tasks.human_edge: The developer recommends the installation and accepts the plan.
tasks.altitude: The developer still analyzes the information and recommends the installation. The file stores only the plan they accepted.

reach.task: Follow an installation plan the developer accepted
reach.learn: Do not treat the plan as permission to change the cutover

evidence.claim: A stored system record can be retrieved. Recommending an installation, and planning it, remain a judgement.
EU rules require literacy for a person who uses a system that drafts text or code. A user-facing bot must identify itself as a machine. This design has no bot.

assumptions: The workflow starts when an installation is proposed and ends when the accepted plan is on file. The developer recommends the installation.

The fields are the system name, the retrieved facts, the recommendation, and their acceptance. The record produces the facts. The developer produces the recommendation. If the facts are missing, they collect them.
The prior classes this task as amplify. The steps disagree: the recommendation and the plan stay with the developer.
unknowns: Whether the existing system record is complete enough to retrieve.
Whether operations must also accept the installation plan.
research_questions: Is the existing system record complete enough to retrieve?
Must operations also accept the installation plan?

already_counted.description: The whole step stays with the software developer
The whole step stays with the software developer
The whole step stays with the software developer

incremental.description: Keep the system-record fields aligned with the plan

approvals.approved_version: installation plan the software developer accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the system record is too thin to retrieve, that reading stays, and the low end is the analysis and the recommendation, which stay either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.short: Retrieve data and read the analysis.

steps.what: Store records the platform already keeps.
Read the analysis of system capabilities.
Note the requirements that analysis supports.

tasks.design: The {DATA_PLATFORM} already stores the records. It retrieves them and applies only rules the developer has stated. The developer reads the capabilities and notes the requirements. Nothing decides a requirement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Extracts were saved by hand, then filtered again for each question.
tasks.enabler_now: The platform already stores the records and can filter them with a rule the developer stated.
tasks.still_hard: Reading what the numbers mean for capabilities and requirements stays with the developer.
tasks.human_edge: The developer reads the analysis and notes the requirements. The filter does not.
tasks.altitude: The developer still reads capabilities and notes requirements. Storage the platform already does is not saved labour.

reach.task: Use a requirements note the developer wrote
reach.learn: The note is their reading, not a generated requirement

evidence.claim: A platform that already stores records is not saved human labour. A stated filter can retrieve and total those records. The person still reads what the result means.
EU rules require literacy for a person who uses a system that drafts text or code. A user-facing bot must identify itself as a machine. This design has no bot.

assumptions: The workflow starts when an analysis is asked and ends when the developer has noted the requirements. They read the result. Storage the platform already does is excluded.

The fields are the record id, the stated rule, and the note. The platform produces the stored record. The developer produces the rule and the note. If the rule is not stated, they do not run a filter.
The prior classes this task as automate. The steps agree a stated filter can run. They disagree that the reading of capabilities can be skipped, and they exclude storage the platform already does.
unknowns: Whether the platform already stores these records.
Which totals the developer has already stated as rules.
research_questions: Does the platform already store these records?
Which totals has the developer already stated as rules?

already_counted.description: The whole step stays with the software developer
The whole step stays with the software developer

incremental.description: Keep the stated filter rules aligned with the question

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the platform does not store the records, retrieval stays, and the low end is reading capabilities and noting requirements, which stay either way. 16 percent is work the system already does and is not saved human labour. Provisional, not a measured result.

steps.what: Design software systems with scientific analysis.

loop.purpose: Draft software from the mathematical models the developer stated.
loop.input: The models and the outcomes the developer measured.
loop.output: A proposed program that has not been written.
loop.check: The developer marks any program whose result disagrees with the measured outcomes.
loop.stop: Stop when the draft is marked ready or rejected. It never writes itself.
loop.why_not_simpler: The program is code. The model formula cannot write the program.

steps.what: Accept the software from those models.

tasks.design: The developer designs the system and states the mathematical models. {DATA_PLATFORM} only computes the formula they wrote. A draft may propose software from those models and the measured outcomes. They accept it. {PROJECT} writes that version.
tasks.previous_blocker: The model, the arithmetic, and the program were one piece of work, and a generated program was easy to treat as the design.
tasks.enabler_now: A platform can compute a formula the developer already stated, and a draft can propose a program from that formula and those outcomes.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the model, and judging consequences the formula does not show, stay with the developer.
tasks.human_edge: The developer states the model and accepts software only when it matches the measured outcomes.
tasks.altitude: The developer still designs the system and states the models. Software is written only after they accept a version that matches the measured outcomes.

reach.task: Supply the inputs the developer named for the model
reach.learn: The developer still states the model

evidence.claim: A formula the person stated can be computed. Choosing the model, and accepting software that is supposed to match it, stay with that person.

A person who uses a system that drafts code must be able to accept or reject that draft. Generated code can contain defects, so a change is written only after the developer accepts that version. Product-security duties can apply when software is placed on the market. This design does not release software.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a design is required and ends when the accepted software is written. The developer states the model. The platform only computes that formula.

The fields are the formula, the inputs, the measured outcomes, and their acceptance. The developer produces the formula. The platform produces the number. If the draft disagrees with the measured outcomes, they reject it.
The prior classes this task as amplify. The steps disagree: the design and the model stay with the developer.
unknowns: Whether the formula is already expressible on the platform.
Whether a scientist must also accept the model.
research_questions: Is the formula already expressible on the platform?
Must a scientist also accept the model?

role.altitude: The developer still accepts status correspondence before it is sent, still recommends the installation, still reads what a filter means, and still states the mathematical model. Storage the platform already does is not their saving.
reach: A project manager reads correspondence the developer accepted
An installer follows a plan the developer accepted
skills_to_grow: Accepting correspondence before it is sent
Recommending the installation rather than having a record recommend it
Stating the mathematical model rather than having a draft choose it
role.ambitious_version: Every letter that is sent, every installation plan that is filed, and every program that is written is one the developer accepted.
